, Reason for Mistake: They incorrectly identified the “non-giver” by taking all employees minus the set of recipients, conflating the person who didn’t receive a gift with the person who failed to give one. Without extracting the Gift Assignments, this inference is invalid—the unmatched person is the non-recipient, while the non-giver is the person assigned to them (which, per the correct solution, is Fred).
